confirmed.title: Drawing and aggregated quantity baseline
confirmed.details: Account required; free entry once per drawing. Address, payment and quantity lock at entry, which cannot be canceled. Selection automatically places an order subject to processing; existing cart cannot combine. General caps may aggregate person, household, order, account, payment and address. Drawing orders below $35 may incur delivery fees; existing-cart items cannot be added to meet the threshold. Walmart reserves the right to prohibit dealers/resellers; its site is for personal, noncommercial use.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm details before entry; profile counts do not expand the permitted household allowance. Rules match prior coverage.
checks: Verify event-specific eligibility/cap and any Walmart+ requirement; no universal Walmart+ requirement verified.
